value_types.label: Claimed by the licensee in the petition
value_types.note: The petition voice; disallowance = petitioned - approved is computed.

value_types.label: Approved by the commission for a future year
Provisionally trued up on unaudited figures (APR / revised estimate)
Finally trued up on audited accounts
Audited actual printed as such (not a decision)
Approved for a year of a multi-year control period in the MYT order

reason_categories.label: Set by a formula or norm in the regulations
Allowed after a prudence check of the claim
Carried forward from an earlier order without re-examination
Disallowed in full or part with reasons
Decision deferred to a later order or true-up
The order prints the number without a reason

line_items.label: Retail sales (energy sold to consumers)
line_items.note: Printed by consumer category; the categories are the tariff categories already in the registry, so a sales row cites the same category code as the rate schedule.

line_items.label: Open-access drawal wheeled through the network
Distribution loss (approved trajectory / trued-up)
aliases: AT&C loss (only when the order approves AT&C, note the role)
line_items.note: The same fact as the existing family distribution_loss_approved (role arr_trajectory or arr_trued_up); never an open-access billing loss.

line_items.label: Energy input at the distribution periphery
line_items.note: Printed by most commissions and recomputed: E.SALES / (1 - E.LOSS.DIST_PCT).

line_items.label: Energy requirement at the state periphery
line_items.note: E.INPUT.DIST / (1 - E.LOSS.INTRA_TX_PCT); inter-state loss applies only to the inter-state share.

line_items.label: Independent power producers and long-term contracts
Energy balance closes
line_items.note: E.PP.QTY - E.PP.QTY.SURPLUS_SALE - inter- and intra-state losses = E.INPUT.DIST, within the identity tolerance.

line_items.label: Energy transmitted / handled at the STU periphery
Approved transmission charges (annual)
aliases: net ARR to be recovered through transmission charges

line_items.label: Transmission charge rate
line_items.note: Unit as printed (INR per MW per month, INR per kW per month, or paise per kWh); the stated unit stays on the fact.

line_items.label: Sharing of transmission charges among users
line_items.note: Per DISCOM (or per long-term user); the distribution licensee's C.TX.INTRA must reconcile with its share here (cross-order identity ARR-I10).

line_items.label: Own generation cost
line_items.note: Mirrors E.PP.QTY.OWN; the average rate per class is C.PP.x / E.PP.QTY.x and is derived, never read.

line_items.label: Central generating stations
line_items.note: Mirrors E.PP.QTY.CENTRAL; the average rate per class is C.PP.x / E.PP.QTY.x and is derived, never read.

line_items.label: State generating company

line_items.label: Fixed (capacity) charges in power purchase
line_items.note: Where the order splits fixed and variable; the what-if engine needs this split (ARR spec section 8).

line_items.label: Income from sale of surplus power
Transmission and system-operation charges (total)
line_items.note: Printed as one line by some commissions; otherwise the sum of its children.

line_items.label: Return to the licensee
line_items.note: Exactly one child applies per commission and regulation period; the mapping's return_basis says which.

line_items.label: Provision for bad and doubtful debts
Gain or loss sharing on controllable items
line_items.note: Signed: an incentive to the licensee is positive, a penalty negative.

line_items.label: Other items not elsewhere classified
line_items.note: "Others" alone is too common a row label to be an alias; it stays unplaced until the mapping names it.

line_items.label: Carrying cost on regulatory asset / revenue gap
Total expenditure
line_items.note: Sum of the printed cost leaves; the printed total reconciles against it (identity ARR-I1).

line_items.label: Less: income set off against costs
Revenue at existing tariff
aliases: revenue from sale of power (existing tariff)

line_items.label: Revenue gap (surplus negative)
line_items.note: R.ARR - R.REV.EXISTING - R.REV.SUBSIDY for the ensuing year; a surplus prints as a negative gap.

line_items.label: Gap recovered through tariff this year
Average cost of supply
line_items.note: Printed by most commissions; recomputed as R.ARR / E.SALES x 10 (crore per MU to INR per kWh).

line_items.label: Consumer contributions, grants and deposit works
Loan repayment (normative = depreciation where the regulation says so)
Rate of interest on working capital
Station-wise power purchase (quantity, fixed cost, variable cost, rate)
line_items.note: Columns: station, source class (E.PP.QTY.*), fiscal year, value type, quantity MU, fixed cost INR crore, variable cost INR crore, total INR crore, rate INR/kWh as printed. Rolls up to C.PP.* and E.PP.QTY.* (identity ARR-I5).

line_items.label: Loan-wise schedule (lender, opening, addition, repayment, closing, rate)
Category-wise sales, consumers and connected load
line_items.note: Rows keyed by the tariff category code; feeds E.SALES.

identities.name: Total expenditure is the sum of its printed components
identities.expression: C.TOTAL = sum(children of C that are printed for the year)
identities.note: A printed total that does not add up means a component was misread or a line is unplaced.

identities.name: Net ARR is total expenditure less the less-items
identities.expression: R.ARR = C.TOTAL - L.NTI - L.OTHER_BUSINESS - L.OA - L.OTHER

identities.name: Revenue gap
identities.note: Some commissions state the gap before subsidy; the mapping's gap_convention says which, and the identity adapts.

identities.name: Energy input from sales and loss
Power purchase cost and quantity roll up from stations
identities.expression: C.PP = sum(X.PP.STATION.total) and E.PP.QTY = sum(X.PP.STATION.quantity), when the detail table is read

identities.name: Energy balance closes
identities.expression: E.PP.QTY - E.PP.QTY.SURPLUS_SALE - inter-state loss share - intra-state loss = E.INPUT.DIST
identities.note: Advisory because commissions apply inter-state loss to different bases; the finding names the base it tried.

identities.name: Fixed plus variable is the power purchase cost
identities.expression: C.PP = C.PP.FIXED + C.PP.VARIABLE - C.PP.SURPLUS_SALE_INCOME, when the split is printed

identities.name: Intra-state transmission charge matches the transmission order's sharing table
identities.expression: C.TX.INTRA (distribution order, utility U, year Y) = T.SHARING[U] (transmission order, year Y)
identities.note: Cross-order: the two orders may be passed months apart; a gap above tolerance is reported, never corrected.

identities.name: True-up chain
identities.expression: final_true_up(Y) in order N+k refers to the same utility and year as approved(Y) in order N; the difference is reported per line
